kind: v28 construction + kappa measured-max + gap/pool charges + ledger

construction.design: production walks nb = 2^66 A-pool bases per side, ell = ceil(N/nb) steps each
construction.identity: records_per_side == nb*ell exactly (integer); N <= nb*ell, N odd, so records_per_side > N by 71672315751858547767 (< nb = 2^66, i.e. < 2^-49.65 of the row)

kappa.method: kappa_charge = MEASURED MAX over walks at fixture + 2x the measured max-minus-mean spread (correlation tail); no expectation is used as a bound
withdrawn: 1 + D/m + envelope_top as a BOUND (v27): an expectation under random assignment does not upper-bound the deterministic key map with shared mu6 keys
kappa.shared_mu6_note: production walkers share the mu6 multiplier structure, so walk collisions are correlated and the realised max is the right charge

base_entry_nw50.derivation: 2nb pool entries x 121 group ops (97 doublings + 24 window additions, derived from the 97-BIT pool scalar, not from the pool-slot count) x 2000 instructions

gap_point_tables.derivation: 2nb bases x |G|=2^11 even gap values (<2^12) x 15 group ops per [a_i*g]P0 (12 doublings + 3 additions) x 2000; these are the base-dependent one-addition gap points and their challenge-side counterparts the verdict named

charges.lookup_already_charged: per-record gap_load_2limb 4 + gap_index 2 + table_point_load 6 = 12 instructions, inside the 238 packing charge: generation was the missing half, not lookup
charges.storage: gap tables 2nb*2^11*48 B = 2^83.6 B; 97-bit pool 2nb*13 B = 2^70.7 B; both below the 2^123.235 B peak

ledger.integer_assert: total == sum(rows); every row a Python int; regenerated from rows
applicability: nw=2^50 geometry: nb=2^66 bases/side, ell=2^49.65 steps
no advice; preprocessing includes pool, gap tables and H-prime supply
